manageHint: Most services can only be managed with the privileged service enabled or with Argus running as administrator.

packaged.title: Change startup type in the registry?
packaged.body:
Windows doesn't let anyone change the startup type of “{name}”, not even administrators: the service belongs to an app package. Argus can write “{type}” to the service's registry key instead.

Windows usually applies it right away; if it doesn't, the table marks it as pending until the next restart. An app update may restore the original value.
packaged.done: Startup type written to the registry.
